extracted.name: Cornmeal Mush
extracted.description: An easy cornmeal mush recipe. Cornmeal cooked with salt and water makes a thick porridge-like dish to use as a hot cereal or a side savory side.
instruction_lines: Mix together water, cornmeal, and salt in a medium saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until mixture thickens, 5 to 7 minutes.
